definitions.explanation: The contamination of water bodies such as rivers, lakes, oceans, and groundwater by harmful substances.

examples.japanese: {水質汚染|すいしつおせん}が{問題|もんだい}になっている。
examples.english: Water pollution has become a problem.

examples.japanese: {工場|こうじょう}の{排水|はいすい}が{水質汚染|すいしつおせん}の{原因|げんいん}だ。
examples.english: Factory wastewater is the cause of water pollution.

examples.japanese: {水質汚染|すいしつおせん}を{防|ふせ}ぐために{厳|きび}しい{規制|きせい}がある。
examples.english: There are strict regulations to prevent water pollution.

notes:
{水質汚染|すいしつおせん} refers to the degradation of water quality due to pollutants. Common sources include industrial waste, agricultural runoff, and sewage.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水質汚染|すいしつおせん}を{防|ふせ}ぐ (to prevent water pollution)
- {水質汚染|すいしつおせん}の{原因|げんいん} (cause of water pollution)
- {水質汚染|すいしつおせん}{対策|たいさく} (water pollution countermeasures)

RELATED ENVIRONMENTAL TERMS:
- {大気汚染|たいきおせん} (air pollution)
- {土壌汚染|どじょうおせん} (soil contamination)
- {水質|すいしつ}{検査|けんさ} (water quality testing)
